description: Get a link (approve_url) for your human to open: they sign in, add funds if needed, set a spending limit and approve. Show them the link, then call get_approval. Use this when a check is refused with free_check_used, insufficient_funds or key_limit.

api_key.description: Optional API key (sia_...), if your connection has none and you got one from get_approval

number.description: US 10-digit phone number, any format, e.g. '2145550100' or '(214) 555-0100'

reason.description: Shown to your human, e.g. 'Check our sales line before Monday's campaign'

name: request_approval
title: Ask your human to approve spending
